Woh prajati jeevit nahi rehti jo sabse majboot hai, balki woh jo sabse aasaani se dhal jaati hai.
Finish line nahi—sirf milestones.
Paani dekhne se samandar paar nahi.
Asli bano.
"Sun shine kare ya na kare—tumko keep going karna hai."

Discipline ke baad motivation aati.
Kal ko haasil karne ki ekmatra seema aaj ke sankoch hain.

Hustle excuses ko hara deta hai.
Aaj ka effort kal ka advantage ban jata hai.
Sabr rakho.
"Kaam se pyaar—success aayega."
